integrity: The Eulerian-support and generating-function arguments are self-contained; finite enumeration is a consistency test, not an infinite proof. The novelty comparison remains subject to unindexed literature. No independent review is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only binary, oriented cyclic length-three substrings counted with multiplicity; no claim for linear words, larger alphabets, or longer observed blocks.
The exact profile-class-size distribution and noisy-channel coding capacities are not determined.
The title source has a verified public full-text date of 2022-08-26; older foundational material is supporting literature, not presented as new.
title: Exact capacity and period-twelve law for cyclic binary trigram profiles
